context: Bedtime. Sho is six and the light is off. Ryosuke is sitting on the edge of the bed.
purpose: comfort + reassurance — dad-to-young-child after a small worry

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お父さん、ちょっと、まだいて。
lines.style: Small, quiet. Almost-whisper. A child not wanting to be alone but trying not to be a bother.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.style: Sits-down voice. Calm, present, no rush. The 「どうした？」 is open, not probing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: なんか、怖い感じがする。
lines.style: Pauses inside the line. The 「なんか」 is a child not having the word yet. Soft and honest.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: うん。本当のこと言うと、お父さんも子どもの時、よくそうだったよ。
lines.en: Yeah. To tell you the truth, when I was a kid I felt that a lot too.
lines.style: Slow, warm. The confession is gentle — making the kid less alone with it. JP and EN: same easy honesty.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Tiny lift of relief. Two syllables that mean a lot.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 本当に。明日まで、ここにいるから。一緒にいよう。
lines.en: Really. I'll be here until tomorrow. Let's be together a while.
lines.style: Steady promise. Slows down for 「一緒にいよう」. The kind of sentence that settles a small body.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Sleepy already. The 「大丈夫」 is half-spoken, almost a sigh.
